CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_suggestions (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 author_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 text TEXT NOT NULL,
 page_path VARCHAR(500),
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 done_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 done_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 CONSTRAINT ck_app_suggestions_text CHECK (length(btrim(text)) > 0)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_app_suggestions_author_id ON app_suggestions (author_id)

INSERT INTO app_suggestions (author_id, text, created_at) SELECT user_id, raw_text, updated_at FROM inbox_notes WHERE resolved_as = 'app_suggestion' AND length(btrim(raw_text)) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app_suggestions) ORDER BY updated_at, id
